title: सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 57 · Fourth day: Abhimanyu in the fight

summary.en: Abhimanyu single-handedly faces Drona's son, Bhurishravas, Shalya and others, like a lion cub among elephants. He cuts down Shalya's horses and fights the Kaurava chiefs with great skill.
summary.kn: ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ, ಭೂರಿಶ್ರವ, ಶಲ್ಯರೇ ಮೊದಲಾದವರನ್ನು ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಆನೆಗಳ ನಡುವಣ ಸಿಂಹಶಿಶುವಿನಂತೆ ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಶಲ್ಯನ ಕುದುರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಂದು ಕೌರವ ಮುಖ್ಯರೊಡನೆ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯದಿಂದ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अभिमन्यु अकेले अश्वत्थामा, भूरिश्रवा, शल्य आदि का सामना हाथियों के बीच सिंह-शावक की तरह करता है। वह शल्य के घोड़े मार देता है और कौरव प्रमुखों से कुशलता से लड़ता है।
summary.te: అశ్వత్థామ, భూరిశ్రవుడు, శల్యుడు మొదలైన వారిని అభిమన్యుడు ఒక్కడే ఏనుగుల నడుమ సింహకిశోరంలా ఎదుర్కొంటాడు. శల్యుని గుర్రాలను చంపి కౌరవ ముఖ్యులతో నైపుణ్యంగా పోరాడతాడు.
summary.ta: அஸ்வத்தாமன், பூரிசிரவஸ், சல்யன் முதலியோரை அபிமன்யு தனியாக யானைகளிடையே சிங்கக்குட்டி போல் எதிர்க்கிறான். சல்யனின் குதிரைகளைக் கொன்று கௌரவத் தலைவர்களுடன் திறமையாகப் போரிடுகிறான்.
summary.ml: ദ്രോണരുടെ പുത്രൻ, ഭൂരിശ്രവസ്സ്, ശല്യർ തുടങ്ങിയവരെ ഒറ്റയ്ക്ക് അഭിമന്യു നേരിടുന്നു; ആനകൾക്കിടയിലെ സിംഹക്കുട്ടിപോലെ. ശല്യരുടെ കുതിരകളെ വെട്ടി അദ്ദേഹം കൗരവ നേതാക്കളോട് വലിയ വൈദഗ്ധ്യത്തോടെ പൊരുതുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.57; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
द्रौणिर्भूरिश्रवाः शल्यश्चित्रसेनश्च मारिष ।
पुत्रः सांयमनेश्चैव सौभद्रं समयोधयन् ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son, Bhurishravas, Shalya, Chitrasena, and Samyamani's son fought with Subhadra's son Abhimanyu, my lord.

verses.text:
संसक्तमतितेजोभिस्तमेकं ददृशुर्जनाः ।
पञ्चभिर्मनुजव्याघ्रैर्गजैः सिंहशिशुं यथा ॥

meaning.en: People saw that one hero locked in close combat with those five tigers among men, of great brilliance, like a lion cub against elephants.

verses.text:
नाभिलक्ष्यतया कश्चिन्न शौर्ये न पराक्रमे ।
बभूव सदृशः कार्ष्णेर्नास्त्रे नापि च लाघवे ॥

meaning.en: In aim, in valor, in prowess, in weapons or in swiftness, none matched the son of Krishna's sister.

verses.text:
तथा तमात्मजं युद्धे विक्रमन्तमरिंदमम् ।
दृष्ट्वा पार्थो रणे यत्तः सिंहनादमथोऽनदत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his own son, subduer of foes, fighting so bravely in the battle, Partha, intent, roared like a lion.

verses.text:
पीडयानं च तत्सैन्यं पौत्रं तव विशां पते ।
दृष्ट्वा त्वदीया राजेन्द्र समन्तात्पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing your grandson pressing their army, lord of the people, your men surrounded him on every side.

verses.text:
ध्वजिनीं धार्तराष्ट्राणां दीनशत्रुरदीनवत् ।
प्रत्युद्ययौ स सौभद्रस्तेजसा च बलेन च ॥

meaning.en: Yet Subhadra's son, undaunted though his enemies were low in spirits, advanced with his brilliance and strength against the Dhritarashtra host.

verses.text:
तस्य लाघवमार्गस्थमादित्यसदृशप्रभम् ।
व्यदृश्यत महच्चापं समरे युध्यतः परैः ॥

meaning.en: As he fought in the battle against his enemies, his great bow, bright as the sun and moving with swift skill, was seen.

verses.text:
स द्रौणिमिषुणैकेन विद्ध्वा शल्यं च पञ्चभिः ।
ध्वजं सांयमनेश्चापि सोऽष्टाभिरपवर्जयत् ॥

meaning.en: With one arrow he pierced Drona's son, with five Shalya, and with eight he struck down the banner of Samyamani's son.

verses.text:
रुक्मदण्डां महाशक्तिं प्रेषितां सौमदत्तिना ।
शितेनोरगसंकाशां पत्रिणा विजहार ताम् ॥

meaning.en: The great spear with golden shaft that Somadatta's son hurled, like a serpent, he knocked aside with a sharp feathered arrow.

verses.text:
शल्यस्य च महाघोरानस्यतः शतशः शरान् ।
निवार्यार्जुनदायादो जघान समरे हयान् ॥

meaning.en: The heir of Arjuna checked the hundreds of dreadful arrows Shalya was shooting, and in the battle killed Shalya's horses.

verses.text:
भूरिश्रवाश्च शल्यश्च द्रौणिः सांयमनिः शलः ।
नाभ्यवर्तन्त संरब्धाः कार्ष्णेर्बाहुबलाश्रयात् ॥

meaning.en: Bhurishravas, Shalya, Drona's son, Samyamani's son and Shala, enraged though they were, could not advance against Krishna's grandson, who relied on the strength of his arms.

verses.text:
ततस्त्रिगर्ता राजेन्द्र मद्राश्च सह केकयैः ।
पञ्चत्रिंशतिसाहस्रास्तव पुत्रेण चोदिताः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Trigartas and the Madras with the Kekayas, thirty-five thousand strong, urged on by your son, king,

verses.text:
धनुर्वेदविदो मुख्या अजेयाः शत्रुभिर्युधि ।
सहपुत्रं जिघांसन्तं परिवव्रुः किरीटिनम् ॥

meaning.en: chief knowers of archery, unconquerable in battle by enemies, surrounded Kiritin, who with his son wished to kill them.

verses.text:
तौ तु तत्र पितापुत्रौ परिक्षिप्तौ रथर्षभौ ।
ददर्श राजन्पाञ्चाल्यः सेनापतिरमित्रजित् ॥

meaning.en: The Panchala prince, the commander Amitrajit, king, saw those two chariot-bulls, father and son, surrounded there.

verses.text:
स वारणरथौघानां सहस्रैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।
वाजिभिः पत्तिभिश्चैव वृतः शतसहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by many thousands of elephants and chariots, and by horses and foot soldiers in hundreds of thousands,

verses.text:
धनुर्विस्फार्य संक्रुद्धश्चोदयित्वा वरूथिनीम् ।
ययौ तन्मद्रकानीकं केकयांश्च परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: that enraged scorcher of foes drew his bow, urged forward his army, and went to the Madraka army and the Kekayas.

verses.text:
तेन कीर्तिमता गुप्तमनीकं दृढधन्वना ।
प्रयुक्तरथनागाश्वं योत्स्यमानमशोभत ॥

meaning.en: Guarded by that renowned strong archer, the army, with its chariots, elephants and horses, looked splendid as it prepared to fight.

verses.text:
सोऽर्जुनं प्रमुखे यान्तं पाञ्चाल्यः कुरुनन्दन ।
त्रिभिः शारद्वतं बाणैर्जत्रुदेशे समर्पयत् ॥

meaning.en: The Panchala, descendant of the Kurus, struck Kripa, son of Sharadvat, with three arrows at the collarbone as Arjuna was advancing in front.

verses.text:
ततः स मद्रकान्हत्वा दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः ।
हृष्ट एको जघानाश्वं भल्लेन कृतवर्मणः ॥

meaning.en: Then, having killed the Madrakas with arrows by tens and tens, he alone, delighted, killed Kritavarma's horse with a broad-headed arrow.

verses.text:
दमनं चापि दायादं पौरवस्य महात्मनः ।
जघान विपुलाग्रेण नाराचेन परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: That scorcher of foes also killed Damana, heir of the great-souled Paurava, with a broad-pointed iron arrow.

verses.text:
ततः सांयमनेः पुत्रः पाञ्चाल्यं युद्धदुर्मदम् ।
अविध्यत्त्रिंशता बाणैर्दशभिश्चास्य सारथिम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Samyamani's son pierced the Panchala, insolent in battle, with thirty arrows, and his charioteer with ten.

verses.text:
सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः सृक्किणी परिसंलिहन् ।
भल्लेन भृशतीक्ष्णेन निचकर्तास्य कार्मुकम् ॥

meaning.en: Badly wounded, the great archer, licking the corners of his mouth, cut off his bow with a very sharp broad-headed arrow.

verses.text:
अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षिप्रमेव समर्पयत् ।
अश्वांश्चास्यावधीद्राजन्नुभौ तौ पार्ष्णिसारथी ॥

meaning.en: Then he quickly struck him with twenty-five arrows, and killed both his horses and the two attendants of his rear wheels, king.

verses.text:
स हताश्वे रथे तिष्ठन्ददर्श भरतर्षभ ।
पुत्रः सांयमनेः पुत्रं पाञ्चाल्यस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Standing on his chariot with its horses slain, the son of Samyamani, bull of the Bharatas, saw the great-souled Panchala's son.

verses.text:
स संगृह्य महाघोरं निस्त्रिंशवरमायसम् ।
पदातिस्तूर्णमभ्यर्छद्रथस्थं द्रुपदात्मजम् ॥

meaning.en: Seizing a fearsome, splendid iron sword, he quickly attacked on foot the son of Drupada on his chariot.

verses.text:
तं महौघमिवायान्तं खात्पतन्तमिवोरगम् ।
भ्रान्तावरणनिस्त्रिंशं कालोत्सृष्टमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: Like a great flood coming, like a serpent falling from the sky, like Death let loose by time, with his sword and shield whirling,

verses.text:
दीप्यन्तमिव शस्त्रार्च्या मत्तवारणविक्रमम् ।
अपश्यन्पाण्डवास्तत्र धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः ॥

meaning.en: blazing with the flash of his weapon, with the stride of a rutting elephant, the Pandavas and Dhrishtadyumna, son of Prishata, watched him there.

verses.text:
तस्य पाञ्चालपुत्रस्तु प्रतीपमभिधावतः ।
शितनिस्त्रिंशहस्तस्य शरावरणधारिणः ॥

meaning.en: As the Panchala's son ran straight at him, sword sharp in hand and shield held,

verses.text:
बाणवेगमतीतस्य रथाभ्याशमुपेयुषः ।
त्वरन्सेनापतिः क्रुद्धो बिभेद गदया शिरः ॥

meaning.en: having passed the speed of arrows and come close to the chariot, the commander in haste and anger split his head with a mace.

verses.text:
तस्य राजन्सनिस्त्रिंशं सुप्रभं च शरावरम् ।
हतस्य पततो हस्ताद्वेगेन न्यपतद्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: King, as he fell dead, his sword and bright shield dropped from his hand and fell to the ground with force.

verses.text:
तं निहत्य गदाग्रेण लेभे स परमं यशः ।
पुत्रः पाञ्चालराजस्य महात्मा भीमविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Having killed him with the tip of his mace, the great-souled son of the Panchala king, terrible in valor, won the highest fame.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्हते महेष्वासे राजपुत्रे महारथे ।
हाहाकारो महानासीत्तव सैन्यस्य मारिष ॥

meaning.en: When that great archer, prince and great chariot-warrior, was killed, a great cry of woe rose from your army, my lord.

verses.text:
ततः सांयमनिः क्रुद्धो दृष्ट्वा निहतमात्मजम् ।
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन पाञ्चाल्यं युद्धदुर्मदम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Samyamani, enraged at seeing his son killed, rushed swiftly at the Panchala, arrogant in battle.

verses.text:
तौ तत्र समरे वीरौ समेतौ रथिनां वरौ ।
ददृशुः सर्वराजानः कुरवः पाण्डवास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: There in the battle all the kings, the Kurus and the Pandavas, watched those two heroes, best of chariot-warriors, meeting.

verses.text:
ततः सांयमनिः क्रुद्धः पार्षतं परवीरहा ।
आजघान त्रिभिर्बाणैस्तोत्त्रैरिव महाद्विपम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Samyamani, enraged, a destroyer of enemy heroes, struck Prishata's son with three arrows, as one strikes a great elephant with goads.

verses.text:
तथैव पार्षतं शूरं शल्यः समितिशोभनः ।
आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धस्ततो युद्धमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: And Shalya, the ornament of assemblies, also enraged, struck the brave son of Prishata in the chest, and the battle went on.
